MASY1-GC1015 | Session 02

Decision-to-Story Analysis Framework

A four-panel clay-style diagram illustrating the path from decision-first KPI framing and grain verification to honest charting and bounded managerial claims.

This four-panel visual overview outlines the workflow for business data storytelling. Panel 1 shows metric framing, where decision horizons, target benchmarks, and guardrails are set prior to calculation. Panel 2 illustrates data grain and join auditing, showing how defining one row per transaction prevents multi-item join fan-outs from distorting counts. Panel 3 demonstrates chart integrity, showing that bar charts require a zero baseline to represent percentage point gaps proportionally. Panel 4 presents the bounded story frame, showing how descriptive evidence supports targeted operational investigations while explicitly acknowledging that correlation does not prove causation.

1. Frame the Metric

Set clear targets and guardrails before examining intake records.

2. Verify Row Grain

Count patient visits once; avoid duplicating rows across joined records.

3. Display Honestly

Use zero baselines on bar charts to show true gaps accurately.

4. Bound the Claim

Report observed shortfalls without asserting unverified causal reasons.

Rigorous analysis connects structured records to cautious operational decisions.
